g_ir.name: ref_all_pairs_builder
g_ir.intuition: Reference builder: all winner/loser pairs by objective ordering.

f_ir.name: loss_margin_rank_blend_tanh_max_advantage_logsumexp
f_ir.intuition: This loss retains the pairwise margin ranking with tanh smoothing but changes the aggregation structure from mean to a log-sum-exp style softmax aggregation over margins weighted by the maximum advantage. This emphasizes pairs with larger weighted hinge losses exponentially more, focusing training on the hardest or most significant pairs, leading to more robust and discriminative margin ranking.
f_ir.pseudocode:
lpw = batch['log_prob_w']
lpl = batch['log_prob_l']
adv_w = batch['advantage_w']
adv_l = batch['advantage_l']
adv_max = maximum(adv_w, adv_l)
margin = alpha * (lpw - lpl)
clamped_margin = clamp(margin, -10, 10)
smooth_margin = tanh(clamped_margin)
weight_factor = abs(adv_max)
hinge = relu(1 - smooth_margin)
weighted_hinge = hinge * weight_factor * weight
max_val = max(weighted_hinge)
lse = log(sum(exp(weighted_hinge - max_val)))
loss = lse + max_val - log(batch_size)
return mean(loss)
f_ir.code:
def generated_loss(batch, model_output, extra):
    eps = 1e-8
    lpw = batch['log_prob_w']
    lpl = batch['log_prob_l']
    adv_w = batch['advantage_w']
    adv_l = batch['advantage_l']
    weight = batch.get('weight', lpw.new_ones(lpw.shape))
    alpha = float(extra.get('alpha', extra.get('hyperparams', {}).get('alpha', 1.0)))
    adv_max = ops.maximum(adv_w, adv_l)
    margin = ops.sub(lpw, lpl)
    scaled_margin = ops.mul(alpha, margin)
    clamped_margin = ops.clamp(scaled_margin, -10.0, 10.0)
    smooth_margin = ops.tanh(clamped_margin)
    weight_factor = ops.abs(adv_max)
    hinge = ops.relu(ops.sub(ops.ones_like(smooth_margin), smooth_margin))
    weighted_hinge = ops.mul(hinge, weight_factor)
    weighted_hinge = ops.mul(weighted_hinge, weight)
    max_val = ops.max(weighted_hinge)
    lse = ops.log(ops.sum(ops.exp(ops.sub(weighted_hinge, max_val))) + eps)
    loss = ops.add(lse, max_val)
    batch_size = weighted_hinge.shape[0]
    loss = ops.sub(loss, ops.log(weighted_hinge.new_tensor(batch_size if batch_size > 0 else 1).clamp(min=eps)))
    return loss
